title: Enable This Feature and Your iPhone Will Reprimand You if Your Lens Is Dirty - CNET
summary: Luckily, iOS 26 includes a feature that can warn you when your camera lens needs cleaning, that way you don’t waste a perfectly good sunset or other Instagrammable moments. It also introduced an easy-to-overlook feature called Lens Cleaning Hints.
